The Bruins, led by fourth-year head coach [[Casey Alexander]], played their home games at the [[Curb Event Center]] in [[Nashville, Tennessee]] as first-year members of the [[Missouri Valley Conference]].{{Cite web |date=2021-09-28 |title=Belmont latest to leave Ohio Valley, to join MVC |url=https://www.espn.com/college-sports/story/_/id/32298563/belmont-bruins-join-missouri-valley-conference-2022 |access-date=2022-10-26 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} They finished the season 21–10, 14–6 in [[2022–23 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball season|MVC Play]] to finish in a tie for third place. They were defeated by [[2022–23 Indiana State Sycamores men's basketball team|Indiana State]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2023 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|MVC tournament]]. ==Previous season== The [[2021–22 Belmont Bruins men's basketball team|Bruins]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 25–8, 15–3 in OVC play to finish in second place. They lost in the semifinals of the [[2022 Ohio Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|OVC tournament]] to [[2021–22 Morehead State Eagles men's basketball team|Morehead State]].{{Cite web |title=Morehead State vs. Belmont - Game Recap - March 4, 2022 - ESPN |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401405881 |access-date=2022-10-26 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} They received an invite to the [[2022 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they lost to [[2021–22 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbilt]] in the first round.{{Cite web |title=Belmont vs. Vanderbilt - Game Recap - March 15, 2022 - ESPN |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401411697 |access-date=2022-10-26 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} The season marked the school's final season as members of the [[Ohio Valley Conference]].{{Cite web |last=Daily |first=Cole |title=Belmont joins the Missouri Valley: What does this mean for Saluki Basketball |url=https://dailyegyptian.com/110314/sports/110314/ |access-date=2022-10-26 |website=The Daily Egyptian}}{{Cite web |last=Spears |first=Joseph |title=Belmont athletics announces move from Ohio Valley Conference to Missouri Valley Conference |url=https://www.tennessean.com/story/sports/college/2021/09/28/belmont-announces-move-missouri-valley-conference-ohio-valley-conference/5894340001/ |access-date=2022-10-26 |website=The Tennessean |language=en-US}} == Preseason == The Bruins were picked to finish in sixth place in the conference's preseason poll.{{Cite web |title=The 2022 MVC preseason poll is out.
